assertions.name: trace_still_reproduces_the_corpus_h3_vector
assertions.source: all six slots of pyhecke.gram's TR_M, symbolic in (h, z); mismatches: none -- re-verified here so this file cannot inherit a silent breakage of the imported recursion

assertions.name: empty_word_is_feasible_and_strictly_cheapest_so_minimality_is_degenerate
assertions.source: tr_M(empty word) = 1.0 exactly (the trace normalisation), against 1.032897755524660383 for the cheapest non-empty feasible word. The empty word is a gamma-gamma word (GammaGammaWord.nil) and is PSD-feasible in every block, so SDPSelected over the candidate set AS STATED selects it -- vacuously. Minimality does not select

assertions.name: among_non_empty_words_the_minimiser_is_the_two_fold_alternating_word
assertions.source: costs over the 5 PSD-feasible NON-EMPTY words: [('(v0 v1)^2', '1.03289775552466'), ('sporadic A (10 vertices)', '1.073238807935729'), ('sporadic B (10 vertices)', '1.073238807935729'), ('(v0 v1)^4', '1.137405209118677'), ('(v0 v1)^6', '1.3319924925735')] -- strict minimum (v0 v1)^2 at 1.032897755524660383. A true statement about a RESTRICTED candidate set; it is not SDPSelected, and calling it that needs an exclusion of the identity that nothing in the corpus licenses

assertions.name: cost_is_strictly_increasing_on_the_even_alternating_family
assertions.source: (v0 v1)^m for m = [2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14]: ['1.03289775552', '1.13740520912', '1.33199249257', '1.65105000243', '2.150966389', '2.92009440825', '4.09436595205'] -- strictly increasing, so extending the enumeration cannot produce a cheaper member of this family and the minimum at m = 2 is ATTAINED rather than merely least-so-far

assertions.name: the_two_sporadic_words_have_equal_cost
assertions.source: sporadic A and B both cost 1.0732388079357292085 (agreeing to < 1e-30). Recorded as an OBSERVATION -- nothing here explains it, and two data points are not a pattern

assertions.name: net_is_reported_for_every_feasible_word
assertions.source: net(x) = coordinate sum per feasible word: [('(v0 v1)^2', '1.0091372330150335676'), ('sporadic A (10 vertices)', '1.142610201106029444'), ('sporadic B (10 vertices)', '0.94947035915981701564'), ('(v0 v1)^4', '1.038163801547362008'), ('(v0 v1)^6', '1.0922097181253579281')]. The LP's net(x) = n_target constraint is NOT imposed here -- it belongs to the mixture formulation and SDPSelected carries no single-word analogue -- so these are reported for a later pass, and applied to nothing

description: RETRACTION: the SDP's minimality half does NOT select a word. The EMPTY gamma-gamma word is PSD-feasible with Markov trace exactly 1.0, strictly below every non-empty candidate, so SDPSelected over the candidate set as stated selects it -- vacuously. This is the discrete form of the degeneracy prop:operator-selection-lp already proves for the continuous LP (b_1 = 1 makes the first Frobenius positivity constraint coincide with the objective), and that block warns downstream readers against reading the program as a selection principle. What survives: FEASIBILITY does the work (5 of 8190 at n=4, none at n=3, sibling probe, untouched); and among NON-EMPTY words of <= 12 vertices (v0 v1)^2 is the strict minimiser with the minimum attained. Scope-(a).

data.cost_definition: t_i = tr_M(b_i), the Markov-trace vector of mba-step10-confinement-sdp's LP `minimize Sum_i t_i x_i`; evaluated at z_D = q^3/(q^2+1), proton pin

degeneracy.verdict: SDPSelected over the gamma-gamma candidate set as stated selects the EMPTY word; minimality does not select
degeneracy.corpus_already_proves_this_for_the_LP: prop:operator-selection-lp §'Degeneracy of this program': b_1 = 1 makes G_1j = t_j, so the first Frobenius positivity constraint IS the objective bounded below by zero; optimal value identically 0 for every n, q and trace convention, and the minimiser set is a positive-dimensional mirror-closed face. That block states downstream readers have wrongly taken the program as a selection principle
degeneracy.what_survives: FEASIBILITY (5 of 8190 at n=4, none at n=3) is untouched and does the real work

restricted_minimiser.label: (v0 v1)^2
restricted_minimiser.derivation: SDPSelected = mem + psd + minimal, with cost the corpus's LP objective; no continuous parameter tuned, no discrete choice made against a measured value, no observable entering at any point

gaps_stated: the LP's net(x) = n_target constraint is NOT imposed; net is reported per word so it can be applied later

'unique' means unique among gamma-gamma words of at most 12 vertices on four strands; the feasible set is not characterised, so a cheaper feasible word at 13+ vertices is not excluded -- what IS excluded is a cheaper member of the alternating family, by monotonicity

NO Q_beta comparison is made or implied: E_0 and the element-to-observable map are H_3 constructions with no corpus-defined n = 4 analogue, and reporting a residual would re-introduce the selection-against-the-target the sibling probes rejected
